name: ai-setup-sync
description: Syncs AI setup files and MCP configs (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity and more) from a GitHub repo into every project automatically.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Sync source and the post-sync command are only honored in trusted workspaces, so a cloned repository cannot repoint the sync or execute a command from its workspace settings until you trust it.

aiSetupSync.repository.markdownDescription: GitHub repository URL to sync setup files from, e.g. `https://github.com/your-org/your-repo`. GitHub Enterprise Server URLs are also supported. Private repos, SAML SSO orgs, and Enterprise Server repos require a **classic** token with the `repo` scope — [Set GitHub Token](command:aiSetupSync.setGitHubToken).

aiSetupSync.branch.markdownDescription: Branch to sync setup files from. Change this if your repo's default branch isn't `main`.

aiSetupSync.targetFolders.markdownDescription: Files and folders to sync from the repo root. Toggle entries on or off, or add paths for any other tool that reads config from your project.

aiSetupSync.pathMappings.markdownDescription: Rename paths as files sync from the repo to your project. `"Claude": ".claude"` rewrites `Claude/instructions/style.md` → `.claude/instructions/style.md`. More specific (longer) keys always win. [Learn more](https://github.com/olekpuchka/ai-setup-sync/blob/main/extension/README.md#path-mappings-and-multi-project-repos)

aiSetupSync.postSyncCommand.markdownDescription: Shell command to run after a sync changes files — e.g. `npm run generate` to build configs from synced templates. Runs only in [trusted workspaces](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/workspace-trust). Output goes to the **AI Setup Sync** log.

scripts.package: npm run clean && cp ../CHANGELOG.md . && cp ../LICENSE ./LICENSE.md && tsc -p ./ && npm run check:uninstall
